about.title: The operating system for digital entrepreneurship
about.p1: FAITH brings buying, selling, hiring, teaching and building into one account, so people can move between roles without starting over.
about.p2: We are starting in Uzbekistan, with Uzbek as our first language, and building for the rest of the world from the first day.
about.p3: Everything here runs on a simple promise: clear fees, recorded money and decisions that a person can explain.

developers.title: Build on FAITH
developers.body: A REST API, signed webhooks and a typed TypeScript SDK for building apps merchants trust.
developers.keysBody: Each key holds only the scopes you grant, and only its hash is stored.
developers.webhooksBody: Every delivery carries a timestamped HMAC signature and retries on failure.
developers.sandboxBody: Test keys return fixed sample data and never touch real records.
developers.security: FAITH never runs third-party code inside its backend. Your app runs on your own infrastructure and reaches FAITH only through the scopes a person granted.

a.fee: FAITH charges 3.5% on completed sales, calculated on the item subtotal after discounts, excluding tax. Payment processing fees and taxes are separate.
a.refund: Request a refund from your order. When the seller approves it, access to the product ends and the matching commission is reversed.
a.payout: Your balance is recorded in the FAITH ledger. Request a payout from your earnings page. Funds are transferred by licensed payment partners.
a.verify: Some platforms only share numbers with the creator's permission. Until an official connection exists, a reviewer checks the numbers against your evidence.
a.languages: Uzbek, Russian, English, Turkish, Kazakh, Arabic, Chinese and Spanish.

legal.draft: This is a working draft for development and has not been reviewed by a lawyer.
legal.terms1: FAITH connects buyers, sellers, creators, employers and developers. Each person is responsible for what they publish and sell.
legal.terms2: FAITH charges a 3.5% commission on eligible completed sales. Payment processing fees and taxes are separate.
legal.terms3: Funds are held and moved by licensed payment partners. FAITH is not a bank and does not hold deposits.
legal.privacy1: We store the information you give us to run your account: your email, profile and activity on the platform.
legal.privacy2: Sellers see your display name and purchases from their store, never your email address. Employers see your profile only if you opt in.
legal.privacy3: You can turn off recommendations or delete your account in settings. Financial records are kept where the law requires it.
